settings.heading: How fresh is what I'm getting, and how long does it last?
settings.row_content: Everything is made in small batches the same day it ships — nothing sits in a warehouse. Most sweets keep 4-5 days at room temperature; namkeen keeps 3-4 weeks in an airtight container. Exact shelf life is listed on each product page since it varies by item.

settings.heading: Do you ship pan-India, and is Cash on Delivery available?
settings.row_content: Yes — we ship across India, and COD is available on every order. Delivery typically takes 2-4 days depending on your city; festival-season orders (Diwali, Rakhi) should be placed a few days early since courier volumes spike.

settings.heading: What's your return and refund policy on perishables?
settings.row_content: Because these are fresh, perishable foods, we can't accept returns once an order has shipped. If something arrives damaged or wrong, email us within 24 hours of delivery with a photo and we'll sort out a replacement or refund — see our full Refund Policy for details.

settings.heading: Can I order in bulk for a wedding or corporate event?
settings.row_content: Yes — write to us at hello@gangaprasadmithaiwala.example with your event date, quantities, and city, and we'll confirm pricing and a delivery timeline. Bulk orders need at least 5 days' notice.

settings.heading: Do you list allergens? I have a nut/dairy allergy.
settings.row_content: Every product page lists full ingredients. Most of our sweets contain dairy (milk, ghee, khoya) and several contain nuts (cashew, pistachio, almond) — please check the ingredients list before ordering if you have an allergy, as everything is made in a shared kitchen.
